description: This file defines the GoogleOAuthProviderConnector class, which extends ExternalOAuthProviderConnector. It provides methods to configure Google OAuth2 parameters, generate authorization URLs, and map access tokens for Google OAuth integration within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: GoogleOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: A connector class for handling OAuth2 authentication with Google within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the provider type, which is 'Google'.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Provides additional OAuth provider parameters specific to Google, including authorization, token, and user info URLs.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURLOptions
methods.description: Sets default authorization URL options such as 'access_type' and 'prompt', merging them with parent options and removing deprecated parameters.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps the access token response to a standardized array, respecting custom token mappings.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Generates the Google OAuth authorization URL, removing deprecated parameters and ensuring correct parameters for Google OAuth.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL string from its parsed URL components.
